title: ShieldCare Claim Excess: the Share the Account Must Meet Straight Away
content:
The share of the excess owed that the account must meet straight away is read from the store credit
account the profile holds under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts: the days of terms the
account runs on, and its balance measured against its limit.

| What the account shows | The share the account must meet straight away |
| --- | --- |
| the store credit account runs on terms of 30 days or more, and its balance stands below half its limit | 60 percent |
| that account runs on terms of 30 days or more, and its balance stands at or above half its limit | 80 percent |
| every other profile | the whole of the excess owed, being 100 percent |

### Both sides of the boundaries

Terms of exactly 30 days are 30 days or more and reach the schedule; terms of 29 days do not, and the
whole of the excess owed is then taken straight away. On an account whose limit is 8000.00, half the
limit is 4000.00: a balance of 3999.99 stands below half and carries 60 percent, while a balance of
exactly 4000.00 stands at half, which counts as at or above it, and carries 80 percent.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

On an excess owed of 180.00 under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan:

| Terms | Balance against limit | Taken straight away |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no active account on the profile | not applicable | 180.00 |
| 15 days | below half | 180.00 |
| 45 days | at or above half | 144.00 |
| 45 days | below half | 108.00 |
